experiments.scope: Step O5 (completion) of algorithm A on fixed accepted matches: the prefixes of the run-found pairs and the published match. Each organizer seed drives the E13/E15 draws through SHAKE-256; caps L13 = 2^14, L15 = 2^8.
experiments.hypothesis: For an accepted match, step O5 completes within the caps for nearly every seed, so kappa is close to 1. Every returned pair is a distinct full sha256-r31 collision.
